equity.equity_measurement: Age is dichotomized at 15 years (adults vs children and adolescents); sex and age breakdowns available only from 2005.

notes: Averted infections and deaths come from Spectrum models compared with a counterfactual holding ART at 2003 coverage; the averted totals are the report's own modeled estimates. Design is inferred: the report calls its indicators measures of program effectiveness but names no design.
view_issues: The viral load suppression 'increased 3%' (91% to 94%) is a 3-percentage-point change, not a 3% relative change. The text says ART rose 'approximately 5,000%' and also gives 4,884%; possible double counting across sites is acknowledged.
